moat_against: Base label materials are commodity-adjacent: competition from UPM Raflatac, Fedrigoni and CCL on price, with raw-material (paper, petrochemical) cost exposure
Cyclical end demand: FY2023 revenue fell and OE/share dropped to $6.64 on destocking; Q2 2026 strength was ~half customer pre-buys that management expects to unwind in H2 2026
Leverage consumes the moat's slack: net debt $3,530,100,000 is 5.19x normalized OE and rose ~$707M in FY2025 as buybacks + dividends ($860.7M) exceeded OE ($684.5M)
Gross margin below 30% and no measured ROIC series in the filing outputs (roic_proxy null) — returns evidence is ROE on a buyback-shrunk equity base, which flatters
moat_for: Global scale leader in pressure-sensitive label materials; materials are qualified into converter/brand specifications, so switching risks label failure for a trivial cost saving
Demonstrated pricing power: price increases held through the 2021-22 inflation cycle and again in Q2 2026 (price up low single digits), gross margin expanded 26.6% -> 28.8% (FY2025), 29.0% TTM
Intelligent Labels / RFID franchise: leading RFID inlay position, high-value categories ~45% of sales, Solutions Group 5-yr revenue CAGR 12.7% vs Materials 3.2%
Durable cash compounding: OE positive 5 of last 5 years, dividend raised every year since the 2010 cut (DPS $3.70 FY2025, $3.82 TTM), share count shrinking -1.61%/yr
moat_justification: Global scale leader in pressure-sensitive label materials with qualified-materials switching costs and demonstrated pricing power (gross margin up from 26.6% to 28.8-29.0% over the last four fiscal years), plus a growing Intelligent Labels / RFID franchise (high-value categories ~45% of sales). Capped at 6: base label materials remain commodity-adjacent and cyclical (OE/share fell to $2.22 in FY2018 and $6.64 in FY2023), gross margin under 30% is not wide-moat territory, and fundamentals.json carries no roic_proxy series for AVY (operating income untagged), so a 7+ score has no measured ROIC history to sit on.
name: Avery Dennison Corporation
one_liner: Steady label-materials compounder, moat 6/10 — does not clear 15% at $175.31 (weighted IRR 8.7%, IV@15% $84.65; clears 15% only below ~$85), and even the rejected working-capital-flattered TTM base yields only 12.0%; quality is real, the price already pays for it.
